title: Group consecutive equal elements into value and count pairs
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It extends the current run when === holds or both elements are NaN, keeping the run's first element and counting into a new array.
It compares JSON.stringify output, so runs([{}, {}]) returns one run of 2 instead of two runs and NaN joins a run of null, while the pasted log claims objects compare by identity.
It compares with === alone, so runs([NaN, NaN, 1]) returns [[NaN, 1], [NaN, 1], [1, 1]] instead of [[NaN, 2], [1, 1]].
Array.prototype.includes compares with SameValueZero, which is the brief's equality, so runs, values and counts all come out as required.
